notes.title: Patch 5: More Flexibility
notes.notes:
Hey, everybody. Long time no see, time for a new patch. This time it's the patch you've been asking for and a little bit more.
We have[b] completely reworked the options menu[/b]. Now the settings management became much more convenient, fixed a lot of problems with the display of current settings. And the most important thing - [b]key bindings[/b]. 
Now you can customize the control for yourself. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/527b1e850ca05cb0b4ad807acdc324fc405b2333.png[/img]

The next updates will be about gameplay improvement, but for now below is the list of what has changed:

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] ✅ Fixed that the current progress of the scattered parcels quest was not displayed after death.
[*] ✅ Fixed some upgrades not being applied to the player when loading the game
[*] ✅ Fixed that after deleting game saves, shelving units could display items from an old save.
[*] ✅ Fixed that fast delivery no longer gave more money for shipping as planned.
[*] ✅ Fixed that when playing with friends, the host could overwrite the saves of players who joined it.
[*] ✅ Fixed that multiple plantains could appear in the same location.
[*] ✅ Fixed that in some cases a delivery vehicle could be invisible when crashing.
[*] ✅ Fixed that package icons could be copied multiple times when assembling a parcel.
[*] ✅ Fixed that fast delivery could be picked up before it landed.
[*] ✅ Fixed that fast delivery could get stuck on other objects when landing.
[/list]

[h1]ADDED[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Completely reworked options menu, improved menu navigation and settings management.[/b]
[*] [b]Added key bindings section to the options menu.[/b]
[*] Added display of scanned parcel in visor when visor upgrade is available
[*] Increased time to search for parcels after a delivery vehicle crash.
[/list]


[h1]KNOWN ISSSUES[/h1]
[list]
[*] ⚠️There may be untranslated words or different spellings of the same item in some places. We are working on this and it will be fixed in the next hotfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Unexpected Difficulties
notes.notes:
This time decided to diversify your gameplay and added a couple of things. 

[b]Emergency delivery[/b]
There are now ‘[b]Emergency deliveries[/b]’. You MUST find it and have it delivered to the address within the time limit, or else.... who knows.
Wait for the airplane to pass and run to find where it fell, the point of fall is marked on the map
For such deliveries, the reward is higher than for ordinary deliveries. But the penalties are commensurate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/6d92a4596d50e06f1631cfb48596609f32eab59c.png[/img]

[b]Arrival[/b]
Added an event during the arrival of the car with boxes - now it can arrive the wrong way. 
As a result, you'll have to run around a bit to fix this

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/e1be468110cff380596aa9716baa0ff57fe5ba1c.png[/img]

[b]Sheathing[/b]
Now in the shop you can buy these upgrades on the boxes - greatly reduce, but not completely remove damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/9a4189f97802bf7e9cdb7b12ecf00f4c4e989122.png[/img]


[b]Small things:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made that the weather outside affects the vegetation, in a downpour it became much more dynamic and lively
[*] A little work has been done with the display of things in the notebook, now it should be more convenient.
[*] Changed the arrangement of boxes on the shelves, now they are located more informative
[*] Added a container in the Delivery point to make it easier to stack packages
[*] Reworked the system with collisions, now you can get stuck only in extreme cases, and even then it is very difficult.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. Glad to introduce new patch to you!
Added some upgrades that are useful to keep your Delivery point rating high and some small improvements to overall quality of life

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] ✅Fixed that a backpack could be incorrectly displayed on the player after death
[*] ✅Fixed that client might not be able to see a visor upgrade with a list of parcels on the screen.
[*] ✅Fixed inactive packs in hand showing on screen with last visor upgrade
[*] ✅Fixed that parcels that were in the drone during save could not be delivered after loading the game. 
[*] ✅Fixed that new boxes on the workbench were spawned into each other
[/list]

[h1]ADDED[/h1]
[list]
[*] ❗Added a disclaimer booth to the main menu
[*]➕Added other sizes of boxes for office trash
[*] ➕Added drone icons to the map
[*] 🔦Added flashlight to the store, now you can not be afraid of the darkness
[*] Added duct tape to the store, allowing you to fix each box 1 time
[*] Added plantain, also allows you to repair each box. Disposable, can be found in the grass
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/e4eba2523f57806c17d53735ac9dcc1f2e8b2419.png[/img]
[*] Added indications for pickup and delivery on the boxes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/e9d4e8601792d24ec6bedef8f684084146a0ebb9.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSSUES[/h1]
[list]
[*] ⚠️Problems with wall collisions, possibility of stucking in there (fixed, in next hotfix)
[*] ☠️ Sometimes you are unable to move (investigating)
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access is Back!
notes.notes:
Thanks to Steam Support team, they helped us a lot and fixed our mistake with missing [b]Early Access[/b].
Now the page in store shows the real state of game.

I apologize for misunderstanding that was created by this fact, and hope for your understanding. 

Though, changing game status to Early Access won't change anything in our working plan, but now you won't be deceived by the game status.

We made a list of features that we will implement in the near future (a month)
[list]
[*] Flashlight
[*] Drones' indicator on map
[*] Flextape for fixing boxes
[*] Plantain also for fixing boxes (in the field)
[*] Indication of teleportation roads of sandboxes
[*] Some new events
[*] More interaction with customers
[*] Wet wipes for cleaning yourself
[*] Variation of events in the building's entrances
[*] Sound and UI additions and improvements
[/list]

Thanks for reading, we will return soon with update news C:

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
Finally, we have fixed major and criticals problems with the game. Thanks to all who participated!
Also, as we had a lot of Brazilian players, it was necessary to add Brazilian localization.

I believe this Patch concludes our work on errors and we can concentrate on adding features and tweaking the gameplay.

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*]Shipment car could not come on client if host was far from delivery point at the start of the day
[*]In tutorial it was possible to "skip time" using the door
[*]If client joined the game later, there could be no dialogue options with the customer
[*]After drone delivery there could remain the delivery point at that address
[/list]

[h1]ADDED[/h1]
[list]
[*]Brazilian, Portugese and French localizations
[*]New pop-up when game autosaves
[*]New pop-up when try to exit the game
[*]New pop-up when try to delete savegame
[*]Minor map changes - more trashbins and vendors
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
The previous patch that aimed to fix drones has failed.
Meet the new patch that aims to fix drones!

According to our information, they now work as intended - they help, not breaking the savegame

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added some conditions to the drone behaviour, even in case of an error the parcel will be delivered and the drone will return to the base.
[*]Fixed the path for drone navigation at Solar, 5
[*]Change in the collision of power lines, it was impossible to deliver a parcel to several flats at Solar, 5. Again.
[*]Fixed issues with not being able to use shelf space after deleting a parcel via computer
[*]Now you can't put a parcel in a closed drone.
[*]Collision of some pipes on the map
[/list]

[h1]CHANGED[/h1]
[list]
[*]Drone speed increased by 25%
[*]Disabled police on the training day, but continue not to break the law.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Drone delivery addresses may still have ‘delivery zones’ (fixed, will be in next patch)
[*]In co-op mode the client may not have a car with parcels, when trying to pass where it should be - teleports to the corner of the map. (not fixed, looking for it)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Our first update - couple of days ago couldn't even think that we will have to fix such problems.
Especially i was saddened about the behavior of drones
But with your help we made it! Better parcel logic and physics, map fixes and all drone problems are resolved (i want to believe)

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Timeflow reduced by 9% (day is longer now)
[*]Rebalanced parcel count after Day 5
[*]New collision tetss to prevent parcels falling through the floor when dropping them
[*]New collisions for doors in some buildings
[*]New method to delete parcels from "database" - parcels could leave with the car and wouldn't be deleted
[*]Fixed icons of delivery zones in some buildings
[*]Fixed visuals of parcel inside the delivery drone
[*]Fixed problems with drone not leaving it's place after giving it a parcel
[*]Now drone doesn't "consume" parcel in case of an error
[/list]

[h1]New[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reworked drone logic from scratch
[*]Now it's possible to delete a parcel, but with some penalty
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/0181fd3bcc3876ac3ea5f96e978aee2f3c60e7c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/7d8373ac7cb28b8b0480cd5ee4f4abae5443e65b.png[/img]
[*]Added new billboards on the road "Where am i?" - in case of bad topography skills it can be handy[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/106b19a37ca86acc858472b95a71104a3bcf06d1.png[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: Playtests are coming!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I'm glad to announce that we are going to have playtests soon, or very soon.
The demo now is pretty outdated, so we decided to test out the new feature from Steam. 
Will be happy to see you soon and listen to your feedback and requests!

notes.title: 1500 wishlists!
notes.notes:
With your help we have achieved a big milestone - [b]1500[/b] wishlists!

We are very happy that a lot of people are interested in our work, it motivates greatly, thanks to everyone involved.

The work will continue and more news are coming!

Thanks again!

notes.title: Road to Release!
notes.notes:
Hello all! 
Sorry for two months of non-posting, but now we have something to share!

In that time we added many features for Delivery point, as well reworked the map a bit.
But first things first.

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*][b]New delivery system[/b]
Now you can have more than 1 item for an address. For that we added [b]parcels[/b] and [b]new boxes[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/68ad2ba8849e1e6261b03e36863da8e1f60ab448.png[/img]

[*][b]Backpack[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/5808e54da119a04155172e502c28e4f1d654f739.png[/img]
Now you can pack parcels and boxes in it
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/1c57da2b1079702db878eb7430708d372c904132.png[/img]

[*][b]Packaging system[/b]
To add some useful micromanagement in the delivery point, we created a system where you can pack parcels in boxes yourself. In the end, parcels in boxes take up less space.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/49ca8b954829e0d01f77c341fd5f49eb51d04fda.png[/img]

[*][b]Delivery Drone[/b]
This smol boi awaits your orders!
Load a box in him and he will deliver it saving some time for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/372b35c3e6019e8467b98352cb76e10fe44e4764.png[/img]

[*][b]Stats[/b]
Added player stats to the TAB menu, so you know what your are capable of. It will come useful later.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015260/f39f6f890b2e4a2ed8ea008da36010ab7e56c01a.png[/img]

These things are finished.
So in the next post i would like to cover features "in-progress".
Here, so i won't forget:
[list]
[b][*]Map rework
[*]Weight system
[*]Navigation update 
[*]Shop update[/b]
[/list]
Thanks for your attention, see you in the end of the weekend!

notes.title: Demo release!
notes.notes:
Good evening all!
Firstly, thanks, that you are reading this. We don't know each other (i guess) but i'm thankful that you visited this page.
Today we released demo version for our [b]Chaos Express[/b].
Though, it is very early version, we thought that it's in state that we can show you.

We cut content down a bit, but got rid of [b]critical bugs[/b] and[b] issues[/b], that can affect core gameplay. It doesn't mean that it's super-stable bug-free version, but we cut 'em down to desirable minimum.
If you experience something, that you think is a bug - post it here, in "[b]Bugs[/b]" topic or in our discord.

We appreciate every feedback and opinion, so feel free to contact us!

Later i'll post about known issues and bugs.
